summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filed by Formula Systems (1985) Ltd., a foreign private issuer, reporting the results of its 2026 annual general meeting of shareholders. The filing discloses the re-election of five board members and the re-appointment of BDO Israel as independent auditor, with each proposal approved. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or management change is present. Under the conservative approach, this is classified as a routine corporate governance update and not a special situation.
